stem:
Kiran hangs a bar magnet so it can turn freely, away from other magnets. She wonders whether paint on one end or a battery is needed.

What does it help her find?

options.text: The direction of the nearest wall.
A direction only after a battery is joined to the magnet.
A direction only if one end of the magnet is painted.

teacher.key_rationale: A freely hanging bar magnet settles along north–south. No battery or paint is required.
